verdict.rationale: The docs say Logfire support is 'built-in (but optional)': agent-run data is sent to Logfire only if the logfire package is installed, configured, and instrumentation is enabled. That makes tracing opt-in and under user control. However, the evidence never says whether the framework or its clai CLI collects any vendor usage telemetry, and documents no explicit opt-out switch. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on vendor usage tracking, a documented telemetry opt-out setting (e.g. an env var or flag) for the library and CLI, independent confirmation that no data is sent by default.
